description: Implement edit modes (Object/Vertex/Edge/Face), vertex manipulation tools (move/scale/rotate for sub-object elements), face extrusion, deletion of vertices/edges/faces, object duplication, grid snapping, per-face color painting with color palette, flat/smooth shading toggle, and export to glTF/GLB and OBJ formats.
steps: Create src/editor/modes/ModeManager.ts - manages switching between Object, Vertex, Edge, Face modes. Updates UI to show current mode. Adds mode toggle buttons to the toolbar.
Create src/editor/modes/ObjectMode.ts - select entire objects, move/rotate/scale with TransformControls from Three.js.
Create src/editor/modes/VertexMode.ts - display vertices as small spheres/points on selected mesh, allow selecting individual vertices, move them with transform gizmo. Updates geometry in real-time.
Create src/editor/modes/EdgeMode.ts - highlight edges on selected mesh, allow selecting edges (pairs of vertices), move/transform edges together.
Create src/editor/modes/FaceMode.ts - highlight individual faces on hover, allow selecting faces, move/transform selected faces.
Create src/editor/tools/ExtrudeTool.ts - when in Face mode with face(s) selected, extrude pushes the face outward creating new side geometry. Integrates with History for undo.
Create src/editor/tools/DeleteTool.ts - delete selected vertices/edges/faces depending on current mode. Rebuilds geometry after deletion. Integrates with History.
Create src/editor/tools/DuplicateTool.ts - in Object mode, duplicate selected object with offset position. Integrates with History.

Create src/editor/tools/TransformTool.ts - unified move/rotate/scale tool that works in all modes, applying transformations to selected elements (objects in Object mode, vertices in Vertex mode, etc.). Supports grid snapping.
Create src/editor/GridSnap.ts - grid snapping utility that quantizes positions to configurable grid size. Toggle on/off via UI button.
Create src/editor/painting/FacePainter.ts - in Face mode, click a face to apply the currently selected color. Modifies vertex colors or face materials. Shows color on the mesh immediately.
Create src/ui/ColorPalette.ts - color palette widget in the right panel with preset colors and a color picker input. Stores current selected color for face painting.

Create src/editor/shading/ShadingManager.ts - toggle between flat shading (flatShading: true, no vertex normal interpolation) and smooth shading (computed smooth normals). Applies to all objects or selected object.
Create src/editor/export/GLTFExporter.ts - export scene to glTF/GLB format using Three.js GLTFExporter addon. Triggers file download.
Create src/editor/export/OBJExporter.ts - export scene to OBJ format using Three.js OBJExporter addon. Triggers file download.
Update src/ui/Toolbar.ts to add export buttons (Export glTF, Export OBJ) and mode toggle buttons.
Update src/ui/ToolPanel.ts to show context-appropriate tools based on current mode.
Integrate all new systems with the History (undo/redo) system so all operations are undoable.
acceptance_criteria: Can switch between Object, Vertex, Edge, and Face modes via UI buttons
In Vertex mode, individual vertices are visible and can be moved
In Edge mode, edges are highlighted and can be selected
In Face mode, faces are highlighted on hover and can be selected
Extrude tool works on selected faces in Face mode
Delete removes selected elements in any edit mode
Duplicate creates a copy of selected object in Object mode
Grid snapping can be toggled and snaps object/vertex positions to grid
Face painting applies color to clicked faces
Color palette allows selecting colors for painting
Flat/Smooth shading toggle changes rendering style on objects
Export to glTF/GLB downloads a valid file
Export to OBJ downloads a valid file
npm run build completes without errors after all changes
verification: Run 'cd /projects/sandbox/Jail && npm run build' and confirm it exits with code 0
Check that dist/ folder is created with bundled output containing all new modules
findings: Build succeeds with expected Three.js chunk size warning (596KB > 500KB). TypeScript compiles cleanly with --noEmit. TransformControls event type required casting event.value as boolean due to @types/three typing the event value as unknown. faceIndex from raycaster intersection is typed as number|null|undefined so used != null check.
